case_name: Younge v. Fulton Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office
title: Two rules on changing course
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

compare.title: Amending a pleading
compare.text: … a party may amend its pleading only with the opposing party’s written consent or the court’s leave. The court should <mark>freely give leave when justice so requires</mark>.

compare.title: Changing the schedule
compare.text: A schedule may be modified <mark>only for good cause</mark> and with the judge’s consent.
